q: 'Plan Bee', the initiative of the Northeast Frontier Railway which keeps wild elephants away from railway tracks and level crossings, works by playing the amplified sound of:
e: Plan Bee deters elephants by amplifying the buzzing sound of honeybees, which elephants naturally fear and avoid, keeping them away from tracks and crossings.

q: The Eighth Central Pay Commission, whose terms of reference were approved by the Union Cabinet in October 2025, is chaired by:
e: The Eighth Central Pay Commission, with terms approved in October 2025, is chaired by former Supreme Court judge Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai.

q: The Railways (Amendment) Act, 2025, which merged the provisions of the Indian Railways Board Act, 1905 into the Railways Act, 1989, gave statutory status to the:
e: The Railways (Amendment) Act, 2025 absorbed the 1905 Board Act into the 1989 Act, thereby giving the Railway Board statutory status for the first time.

q: India's largest Gati Shakti Cargo Terminal for automobiles, inaugurated in June 2025 at a major automobile plant in Haryana, is located at:
e: The Manesar terminal, at Maruti Suzuki's Haryana plant, is India's largest Gati Shakti Cargo Terminal for automobiles, inaugurated in June 2025.

q: Matunga railway station in Mumbai entered the Limca Book of Records in 2018 as the first railway station in India to be:

options.D: Staffed and managed entirely by women

e: Matunga on Central Railway entered the Limca Book of Records in 2018 as the first Indian station staffed and managed entirely by women.

q: The 'Kashi Tamil Sangamam', the month-long cultural exchange programme at Varanasi for which special trains bring delegates from Tamil Nadu, was first organised in the year:
e: Kashi Tamil Sangamam was first held at Varanasi in 2022, with special trains bringing Tamil Nadu delegates for the month-long cultural exchange.

q: India's first 'Restaurant on Wheels', created inside two refurbished coaches to serve food to passengers and the general public, was opened in February 2020 at:
e: India's first Restaurant on Wheels, made from two refurbished coaches, opened at Asansol station in February 2020.

q: The redeveloped Begumpet railway station in Hyderabad, inaugurated in May 2025 under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme, is operated entirely by:
e: The redeveloped Begumpet station, opened in May 2025 under Amrit Bharat, is operated entirely by women staff.

q: The first air-conditioned EMU local train service of the Kolkata suburban network, introduced in August 2025, was run by Eastern Railway between Sealdah and:
e: Eastern Railway's first AC EMU in the Kolkata suburban network, introduced in August 2025, ran between Sealdah and Ranaghat.

q: The 'Shri Jagannath Yatra' Bharat Gaurav Deluxe AC tourist train, first flagged off from Delhi in January 2023, is operated by the:

options.D: Indian Railways Catering and Tourism Corporation

e: The Shri Jagannath Yatra Bharat Gaurav Deluxe AC tourist train from Delhi is operated by IRCTC, which runs the Bharat Gaurav tourist train scheme.

q: The Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL), the special purpose vehicle set up to plan, build and operate the dedicated freight corridors, was incorporated in the year:
e: DFCCIL, the SPV for planning, building and operating dedicated freight corridors, was incorporated in 2006.

q: The National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL), the company implementing India's first high-speed rail corridor between Mumbai and Ahmedabad, was incorporated in the year:
e: NHSRCL, implementing the Mumbai-Ahmedabad high-speed rail corridor, was incorporated in 2016 as a joint venture for the bullet train project.

q: The Centre for Railway Information Systems (CRIS), the information technology organisation of Indian Railways that develops and maintains its major computer applications, was set up in the year:
e: CRIS, Indian Railways' IT arm that develops its major applications like reservation and freight systems, was set up in 1986.

q: The Railway Sports Promotion Board (RSPB), the apex body for the promotion of sports and games on Indian Railways, is headquartered at:
e: The Railway Sports Promotion Board, the apex sports body of Indian Railways, has its headquarters at New Delhi.

q: How many railway divisions are there under the South Western Railway, with headquarters at Hubballi?
e: South Western Railway has three divisions - Hubballi, Bengaluru and Mysuru - under its Hubballi headquarters.

q: How many railway divisions are there under the West Central Railway, with headquarters at Jabalpur?
e: West Central Railway has three divisions - Jabalpur, Bhopal and Kota - under its Jabalpur headquarters.

q: How many railway divisions are there under the South East Central Railway, with headquarters at Bilaspur?
e: South East Central Railway has three divisions - Bilaspur, Raipur and Nagpur - under its Bilaspur headquarters.

q: How many railway divisions are there under the North Western Railway, with headquarters at Jaipur?
e: North Western Railway has four divisions - Jaipur, Ajmer, Bikaner and Jodhpur - under its Jaipur headquarters.

q: How many railway divisions are there under the East Central Railway, with headquarters at Hajipur?
e: East Central Railway has five divisions - Danapur, Dhanbad, Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya, Sonpur and Samastipur - under Hajipur.

q: How many railway divisions are there under the Northeast Frontier Railway, with headquarters at Maligaon (Guwahati)?
e: Northeast Frontier Railway has five divisions - Katihar, Alipurduar, Rangiya, Lumding and Tinsukia - under Maligaon.

q: How many railway divisions are there under the Western Railway, with headquarters at Mumbai Churchgate?
e: Western Railway has six divisions - Mumbai Central, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Ratlam, Rajkot and Bhavnagar - under Mumbai Churchgate.

q: How many railway divisions are there under the North Eastern Railway, with headquarters at Gorakhpur?
e: North Eastern Railway has three divisions - Izzatnagar, Lucknow and Varanasi - under its Gorakhpur headquarters.

q: The Lalgarh Workshop at Bikaner in Rajasthan, which undertakes the overhaul of coaches and wagons, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Lalgarh Workshop at Bikaner lies in the Bikaner division area and functions under North Western Railway.

q: The Wagon Repair Workshop at Raipur, which undertakes the periodic overhaul of freight wagons, functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Wagon Repair Workshop at Raipur does periodic overhaul of freight wagons under South East Central Railway.

q: The Rolling Stock Workshop at Dahod in Gujarat, which undertakes the periodic overhaul of freight stock, functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Rolling Stock Workshop at Dahod in Gujarat functions under Western Railway for freight stock overhaul.

q: The Coach Rehabilitation Workshop at Nishantpura, Bhopal, which undertakes the mid-life rehabilitation of passenger coaches, functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Coach Rehabilitation Workshop at Nishantpura, Bhopal does mid-life rehabilitation of coaches under West Central Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Rourkela in Odisha, which homes electric locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Rourkela, in the Chakradharpur division, functions under South Eastern Railway.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Phulera in Rajasthan, which homes diesel locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Phulera in Rajasthan functions under North Western Railway.

q: In the tax administration of India, the abbreviation 'CBDT' stands for:
e: CBDT is the Central Board of Direct Taxes, the apex body administering direct taxes like income tax under the Finance Ministry.

q: In the Government of India, the abbreviation 'DPIIT' stands for:

options.A: Department for Promotion of Industries and Internal Trading
options.B: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
options.C: Directorate for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
options.D: Department of Promotion of Industrial Investment and Trade

e: DPIIT is the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

q: In the civil aviation administration of India, the abbreviation 'DGCA' stands for:
e: DGCA is the Directorate General of Civil Aviation, India's civil aviation regulator for safety and licensing.

q: In the technical education administration of India, the abbreviation 'AICTE' stands for:

options.A: All India Council for Technical Education
options.B: All India Committee for Technical Education
options.C: All India Council for Technological Education
options.D: Association of Indian Colleges of Technical Education

e: AICTE is the All India Council for Technical Education, the statutory regulator for technical education in India.

q: In the family of railway production units, the abbreviation 'RCF' stands for:
e: RCF is Rail Coach Factory, Kapurthala, a coach production unit of Indian Railways; the word order is Rail Coach, not Railway Coach.

q: In the family of railway production units, the abbreviation 'BLW' stands for:
e: BLW is Banaras Locomotive Works at Varanasi, formerly Diesel Locomotive Works, renamed in line with its Banaras location.

q: The first Vande Bharat Express service of Odisha, flagged off in May 2023, runs between Howrah and:
e: Odisha's first Vande Bharat, flagged off in May 2023, runs between Howrah and Puri, serving the Jagannath pilgrim route.

q: The first Vande Bharat Express service of Uttarakhand, flagged off in May 2023, connects Dehradun with which terminal in Delhi?
e: Uttarakhand's first Vande Bharat, flagged off in May 2023, connects Dehradun with Anand Vihar Terminal in Delhi.

q: The first Vande Bharat Express service of Goa, flagged off in June 2023, connects Madgaon with which Mumbai terminal?
e: Goa's first Vande Bharat, flagged off in June 2023, connects Madgaon with Mumbai CSMT.

q: The first Vande Bharat Express service of Jharkhand, flagged off in June 2023, connects Ranchi with:
e: Jharkhand's first Vande Bharat, flagged off in June 2023, connects Ranchi with Patna.

q: The New Pamban Bridge, inaugurated in April 2025 to connect Rameswaram with the mainland, is India's first railway sea bridge of which type?
e: The New Pamban Bridge is India's first vertical-lift railway sea bridge; its central span rises vertically to let ships pass.

q: The Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Rail Link (USBRL) project, completed and dedicated to the nation in June 2025, has a total length of about:
e: The USBRL project linking Udhampur, Srinagar and Baramulla is about 272 km long and was dedicated to the nation in June 2025.

q: In August 2025, Kolkata Metro services were extended to Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport with the opening of which metro station?
e: Kolkata Metro reached the airport in August 2025 with the opening of Jai Hind station at Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport.

q: The priority corridor of the Kanpur Metro, opened for public service in December 2021, connects IIT Kanpur with:
e: Kanpur Metro's priority corridor, opened in December 2021, runs from IIT Kanpur to Moti Jheel.

q: The first section of the Lucknow Metro, opened for public service in September 2017, ran between Transport Nagar and:
e: Lucknow Metro's first section, opened in September 2017, ran from Transport Nagar to Charbagh.

q: The Aqua Line of the Noida Metro, opened for public service in January 2019, connects Noida Sector 51 with:
e: Noida Metro's Aqua Line, opened in January 2019, connects Noida Sector 51 with Depot Station in Greater Noida.

q: The first section of the Jaipur Metro, opened for public service in June 2015, ran between Mansarovar and:
e: Jaipur Metro's first section, opened in June 2015, ran from Mansarovar to Chandpole.

q: The first Vande Bharat Express service of Telangana, flagged off in January 2023, connects Secunderabad with:
e: Telangana's first Vande Bharat, flagged off in January 2023, connects Secunderabad with Visakhapatnam.

q: Which railway station of the Central Railway in Mumbai became, in 2017, the first station in India to be operated entirely by women staff?
e: Matunga station of Central Railway in Mumbai became, in 2017, the first Indian station operated entirely by women staff.

q: The first Vande Bharat Express in the orange-grey livery, flagged off in September 2023, was run between Thiruvananthapuram Central and:
e: The first orange-grey liveried Vande Bharat, flagged off in September 2023, ran between Thiruvananthapuram Central and Kasaragod.

q: The first section of the Hyderabad Metro, opened for public service in November 2017, ran between Miyapur and:
e: Hyderabad Metro's first section, opened in November 2017, ran from Miyapur to Nagole.

q: The first section of the Ahmedabad Metro, opened for public service in March 2019, ran between Vastral Gam and:
e: Ahmedabad Metro's first section, opened in March 2019, ran from Vastral Gam to Apparel Park.
